hypothesis: hypothesis.md: removing 1R target and holding until confirmed opposing daily Dow state captures sustained reversals and improves net R; initial structural stop remains
baseline: double_repo_8 and double_repo_10 original 1R exits; training comparison only
entry_timeframe: 1d stored calendar dates, Sunday merged Monday; observed M1 directly reduced to daily OHLC
entry_rules: unchanged previous Double Repo 8/10 and next observed daily open; see hypothesis.md

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: variable; user requested Dow reversal holding instead of 1R target
exit_rules.initial_stop: unchanged thrust-start through signal extreme +/- 0.1 Wilder ATR14
exit_rules.dow: latest two strict confirmed pivot highs and lows both higher -> up, both lower -> down; mixed/equal retains state
exit_rules.dow_arming: each new position starts unarmed; after entry, including entry-day close, aligned Dow state arms exit; a subsequent new transition to opposite state signals exit at next observed daily open
exit_rules.pivot_availability: pivot index + right bars at daily close only; simultaneous high/low update atomically
exit_rules.same_type_pivots: all strict pivots accepted without alternating filter
exit_rules.entry_day_opposite_state: does not exit; wait for post-entry aligned state before later opposing transition
exit_rules.boundary: unrealized separately, pending Dow exit not executed outside period

final_period_prior_exposure: All evaluation eras already used in project research. Previous experiment training outcomes seen. Frozen new exit is developed without validation/final P&L feedback; no untouched holdout claim.

cost_and_fill_model.order: open SL gap, pending Dow next-open exit, intraday initial SL, close Dow signal
cost_and_fill_model.risk_ratio: net result divided by fixed initial risk; no TP for Dow
cost_and_fill_model.limitations: unknown actual swap for multi-day holdings; 1pip/calendar-day hypothetical carry sensitivity reported, no adoption approval

position_sizing_and_currency: one position per symbol, equal initial R score, no currency-converted account or compounding

acceptance_gates.baseline_comparison: training same entry/SL old RR1 rerun, descriptive delta only
acceptance_gates.selection: select at most one training-passing candidate by max min-cost PF, max min-cost average R, min max-cost aggregate DD, lexical id; save before validation; no fallback; validation pass then save selection before single final confirmation
acceptance_gates.failure_stop: no pass stops with later-period outcomes undisclosed and no redesign
acceptance_gates.boundary_sensitivity: open positions marked closed separately; not used for formal gate

cross_symbol_rule: 15 equal-risk symbols, each training/validation profitable >=10, final >=8 each cost case
code_identifier: scripts/research_dinapoli_3x3_daily_dow_exit.py and imported prior daily engine; SHA256 before simulation
frozen_at: 2026-09-10; actual UTC and hashes recorded before simulation
